import os, subprocess, tempfile
from pathlib import Path

wt=Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/selfdev-20261007")
expected_head="6e640530c9ae908e01c193cc8eaa983812813bab"
expected_main="6afd748124419208daf19cf79f254e2830348b70"

def run(args, check=True, env=None):
    return subprocess.run(args,cwd=wt,text=True,capture_output=True,check=check,env=env)

head=run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip()
branch=run(["git","branch","--show-current"]).stdout.strip()
status=run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout.strip()
if head!=expected_head or branch!="feat/self-dogfood-20261007" or status:
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected state head={head} branch={branch} status={status!r}")

fetch=run(["git","fetch","origin","main"],check=False)
print("=== fetch ===")
print(fetch.stdout); print(fetch.stderr)
if fetch.returncode:
    raise SystemExit(fetch.returncode)
origin_main=run(["git","rev-parse","origin/main"]).stdout.strip()
print("origin_main="+origin_main)
if origin_main!=expected_main:
    raise SystemExit(f"origin/main moved unexpectedly: {origin_main}")

merge=run(["git","merge","--no-ff","--no-commit","origin/main"],check=False)
print("=== merge stdout ==="); print(merge.stdout)
print("=== merge stderr ==="); print(merge.stderr)

conflicts=run(["git","diff","--name-only","--diff-filter=U"],check=False).stdout.splitlines()
print("conflicts="+repr(conflicts))

if conflicts:
    allowed={"README.md","src/do_again/cli.py"}
    unexpected=set(conflicts)-allowed
    if unexpected:
        run(["git","merge","--abort"],check=False)
        raise SystemExit(f"unexpected merge conflicts: {sorted(unexpected)}")

    if "README.md" in conflicts:
        run(["git","checkout","--ours","--","README.md"])
        readme=(wt/"README.md").read_text()
        section = """## Continuous development and stall reporting

A healthy daemon is not proof that the agent is progressing. Continuous development is opt-in per project. For an ongoing goal, add these values under [do_again] in do-again.toml:

~~~toml
continuous = true
idle_seconds = 1800
recovery_seconds = 900
report_stalls = true
stall_issue_repo = "YOUR_ORG/do-again"
~~~

With continuous mode enabled, Do Again evaluates project liveness after browser receipt delivery is drained. It waits during active model generation or pending local requests, performs bounded durable continuation for an idle unfinished goal, and escalates repeated no-progress or stuck states instead of prompting forever.

Issue reporting is optional and requires an authenticated GitHub CLI with permission to create issues in the configured destination. Reports are sanitized and deduplicated; browser content, credentials, prompts, candidate/customer data, and raw private logs are excluded. If GitHub reporting is unavailable, local liveness state remains visible through do-again status.

Continuous mode does not make browser submission equivalent to acknowledged progress, does not replay uncertain non-idempotent claims, and does not change application/submission authorization. Disable continuous mode for intentionally completed or paused projects.

"""
        marker="## Security model\n"
        if marker not in readme:
            raise SystemExit("README insertion marker missing")
        if "## Continuous development and stall reporting" not in readme:
            readme=readme.replace(marker,section+marker,1)
        (wt/"README.md").write_text(readme)

    if "src/do_again/cli.py" in conflicts:
        run(["git","checkout","--ours","--","src/do_again/cli.py"])
        cli_path=wt/"src/do_again/cli.py"
        cli=cli_path.read_text()
        block='''        liveness_path = layout.state_dir / "liveness.json"
        if liveness_path.is_file():
            try:
                liveness = json.loads(liveness_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
                liveness = {}
            if isinstance(liveness, dict):
                print(f"liveness_state={liveness.get('state', 'unknown')}")
                print(f"liveness_last_progress={liveness.get('progress_at')}")
                print(f"liveness_recovery_attempts={liveness.get('attempts', 0)}")
                if liveness.get("issue_report"):
                    print(f"liveness_issue_report={liveness['issue_report']}")
                if liveness.get("issue_number"):
                    print(f"liveness_issue_number={liveness['issue_number']}")
'''
        if "liveness_state=" not in cli:
            anchor='''                if delivery.get("error"):
                    print(f"browser_delivery_error={delivery.get('error')}")
'''
            if anchor not in cli:
                raise SystemExit("CLI liveness insertion anchor missing")
            cli=cli.replace(anchor,anchor+block,1)
        cli_path.write_text(cli)

    run(["git","add","README.md","src/do_again/cli.py"])
    remaining=run(["git","diff","--name-only","--diff-filter=U"],check=False).stdout.strip()
    if remaining:
        raise SystemExit("unresolved conflicts remain: "+remaining)

if merge.returncode not in (0,1):
    raise SystemExit(merge.returncode)

# Verify watchdog files from upstream are present and exact enough before tests.
for rel in ["src/do_again/service/liveness.py","tests/test_liveness.py"]:
    if not (wt/rel).is_file():
        raise SystemExit(f"missing merged watchdog file: {rel}")

env=os.environ.copy()
env["PYTHONPATH"]=str(wt/"src")

focused=run(["python3","-m","unittest","tests.test_liveness","tests.test_cli"],check=False,env=env)
print("=== focused stdout ==="); print(focused.stdout)
print("=== focused stderr ==="); print(focused.stderr)
print("focused_rc="+str(focused.returncode))
if focused.returncode:
    raise SystemExit(focused.returncode)

full=run(["python3","-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests","-v"],check=False,env=env)
print("=== full stdout ==="); print(full.stdout)
print("=== full stderr ==="); print(full.stderr)
print("full_rc="+str(full.returncode))
if full.returncode:
    raise SystemExit(full.returncode)

commit=run(["git","commit","-m","Merge main watchdog work into self-dogfood PR"],check=False)
print("=== commit ==="); print(commit.stdout); print(commit.stderr)
if commit.returncode:
    raise SystemExit(commit.returncode)

print("new_head="+run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip())
print("status_after="+repr(run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout))
